You have signed the CLA already but the status is still pending? Let us [recheck](https://cla-assistant.io/check/shopware/shopware?pullRequest=22789) it.

Warnings
:warning: The Pull Request doesn't contain any release info, if your changes are relevant for external developers please add an entry to the release info file, including the consequences of the change and how it affects external developers. For detailed infos please refer to the [release documentation guide](https://github.com/shopware/shopware/blob/trunk/delivery-process/documenting-a-release.md).

Tested against a real production catalog (local copy, 6.7.14.1, ~22k products, 8,988 exported rows, Google Shopping CSV whose body template still had a `{% set %}` ternary on `product.cover`).

Associations from `ProductExportGenerator::getAssociations()`: the patch removes exactly the two bogus paths (`cover.product.cover.media`, `mainCategories.product.mainCategories.category`); all other associations unchanged. The new bare tokens (`url`, `brand`, ...) resolve to `null` in `EntityDefinitionQueryHelper::getAssociationPath()` and are dropped by `array_filter`.

`product-export:generate --force` (`read_buffer_size: 50`):

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| runtime | 215 s / 231 s (2 runs) | 61 s |
| peak RSS | 3.35 / 3.26 GB | 1.28 GB |
| output | | byte-identical (`cmp`) |

Single-path `{% set %}` and `{% for %}` aliasing unchanged.
Not covered: the partial-generation (queue) path; #19564 is unrelated and still open. 👍
